effectEntries.effect: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.

descriptions.text: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each target once.
The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.
Der Anwender greift zweimal mit Grolldra an. Bei zwei Zielen werden beide jeweils einmal angegriffen.
The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each target once.
El usuario ataca propulsando a ambos Dreepy. En caso de haber dos adversarios, cada Dreepy golpea a su propio objetivo por separado.
El usuario ataca propulsando a ambos Dreepy. En caso de haber dos adversarios, cada Dreepy golpea a su propio objetivo por separado.
Le lanceur attaque en propulsant deux Fantyrm. S’il y a deux adversaires, chacun d’entre eux est frappé par un Fantyrm.
Chi la usa attacca due volte sparando Dreepy. Quando sono presenti due bersagli, vengono colpiti entrambi una sola volta.
ドラメシヤで ２回 攻撃。 相手が ２匹 いるときは それぞれに １回ずつ 攻撃する。
ドラメシヤで ２かい こうげき。 あいてが ２ひき いるときは それぞれに １かいずつ こうげきする。
드라꼰으로 2번 공격한다. 상대가 2마리일 때는 각각 1번씩 공격한다.
让多龙梅西亚进行２次攻击。 如果对手有２只宝可梦， 则对它们各进行１次攻击。
讓多龍梅西亞進行２次攻擊。 當對手場上有２隻寶可夢時， 則向牠們各進行１次攻擊。
